title: Store upload-match state in proper tables instead of the settings table
acceptance_criteria: Given a pending match, when it is stored, then it lives in an upload_matches table keyed by the placeholder paper, with foreign keys to the placeholder, the library paper and the document, all ON DELETE CASCADE.

Given an attached or replaced upload, when its placeholder is retired, then the redirect lives in a paper_redirects table whose target is a foreign key with ON DELETE CASCADE, so a deleted target removes the redirect.
Given an upload into a chosen paper whose DOI belongs to another paper, when it is recorded, then the owner is a nullable documents.doi_owner_paper_id foreign key with ON DELETE SET NULL.
Given the library listing, sidebar and picker, when they exclude pending placeholders, then they use an indexed join or NOT EXISTS on upload_matches, not key-prefix string matching.

Given existing prefixed rows in model_configurations, when migration 0009 runs, then valid rows move to the new tables, orphans are dropped, the prefixed rows are deleted, and the downgrade restores them.
Given every ARA-086 matching behaviour, when the suites run, then the API and the UI behave exactly as before; only storage changes.
test_cases: Migration upgrade from 0008 with prefixed rows, including orphans; downgrade round trip.
Cascade: deleting a library paper, a placeholder or a document cleans up its match, redirect and owner state.
Existing upload-match integration tests pass unchanged against the new storage.
A health readiness drift test passes at the new head.
verification: Completed 2026-10-09 in the isolated ara-match-test project. Red first: the migration test failed with 'Extra items in the left set: upload_matches, paper_redirects'; 7 integration tests failed with "ImportError: cannot import name 'UploadMatch'" / "'Document' object has no attribute 'doi_owner_paper_id'"; the two head-pin tests failed with "assert '0008_library_embeddings' == '0009_upload_match_tables'". Green: full backend suite 1005 passed; frontend check 574 tests passed; build succeeded; regenerated generated.ts from app.openapi() is identical to the committed file. No live-data migration run; the migration was exercised on an isolated database only. Alembic path_separator = os added; the full suite then reported 1005 passed with no warnings.
